name: Smooth Talker
teaser: Today your PMC could be as dumb as yesterday but a little more talkative.
description_html:
If your flatmates/special one are tired of you yelling “Grenade!”, “One down!” or “Reloading!” then this is the mod for you.

What does it do ?:

Heavily inspired by ssh’s VocalPlayer, this mod autoplays voicelines when your PMC performs specific actions like :

  • Killing a PMC
  • Killing a Scav
  • Being shot at
  • Reloading
  • Throwing a grenade
  • Firing with an empty chamber
  • Pinging close to one of your team mates’ ping plays a confirmation voiceline
  • Pinging an enemy plays a Spotted voiceline

Customizable:

  • Cooldown between voicelines
  • What voicelines to play
  • Delay between kill and confirming the kill
  • Schizo mode if you’d like to talk to yourself or multiplayer only if you’re more of the social type

TIP: Use the empty chamber setting to test the voicelines in the hideout

Installation:

  1. Open the downloaded zip file.

  2. Drag the BepInEx folder from the zip file into your SPT folder.

Disclaimer:

After having thought about it for a while I’m going to retire from modding for the time being.

I’m relying way too much on AI to do most of the heavy work. Whenever I see AI art I can’t stop myself from being disgusted by it and I’ve come to feel the same way about AI mods. Hence why I’ve decided to stop modding altogether and dedicate the free time I have to learn C# and Unity.

The only thing I’ll keep updated will be the per-scope config for PiP-Disabler.

If anyone wants to maintain my mods they’re free to do so ! Although PiP-Disabler is an absolute mess and would probably need to be rewritten from the ground up to be maintainable…
